title: Is It Still You?
question: If every part of you changes, what is it that stays you?

lines.say: [softly] This ship had every plank replaced... one by one.
[thoughtful] The sail. The mast. [pause] Until nothing original was left.
[curious] But someone kept the old planks... and built them back into a ship. [pause] So which one is the real one?
[softly] Now look at her. [pause] Most of what she's made of... will be replaced.
[thoughtful] Her beliefs will change. Her friends will change. [pause] Even her memories will quietly rewrite themselves.
[softly] So is she still the girl who stood here first?
[whispers] If every part of you changes... [pause] what is it that stays you?

music_prompt: Soft solo piano with gentle sea ambience feel, slow, reflective and tender, light celesta accents, sparse notes with space, warm reverb, airy pad. Calm intro, a gently evolving theme that changes a little each time it repeats, a soft pause near the end, ending on an open chord. Instrumental.
